Status: Version 2 adds the S1 events of spec 13 section 9.2 to the approved FIN events of version 1 (decision 35, unchanged). The new events, rules and texts are a proposed default written by an AI agent, to be reviewed by the treasury; the tenant may override a text (IsTenantOverride = 1).

Placeholders.source: fin.v_EarlyWarningMessageValues (db/static/051), by the MessageId of the notification request; a placeholder with Ar and En columns takes the column of the template's language
Placeholders.payload: The events outside FIN take their placeholders from the "values" object of their notification.requested payload, written by the application or the database in the same transaction as the event; a value may be a text or {"ar": ..., "en": ...}. No restricted value is ever a placeholder (BR-NTF-008): no identity, account or IBAN number.

Content: Version 1: FIN.READINESS_RED and FIN.READINESS_AMBER (ADR 0027, ADR 0028, ADR 0030). Version 2 adds the S1 events: DOC.EXPIRY, IDDOC.EXPIRY, INS.RELATIONSHIP_NO_RM, SEC.LOCKOUT, SEC.SENSITIVE_PERMISSION_CHANGED, SEC.MFA_RESET, SEC.REVEAL_ANOMALY, SEC.SUPPORT_ACCESS, PLT.TRIAL_ENDING, PLT.QUOTA, PLT.INTEGRITY_FAIL, JOB.FAILED and NTF.DELIVERY_DEAD. The other events of section 9.2 join with their slices.
